entities.name: Table T1 – Macro global economic performance from 2018 to 2026
entities.brief: Global CAI and GDP performance 2018–2026
entities.description: Displays global Current Activity Indicator and historical GDP trends, highlighting the 2020 V-shaped contraction and forecasted stabilization at modest growth rates.

properties.key_insight: The global economy experienced a dramatic V-shaped contraction in early to late 2020 followed by stabilization at modest 2–3% growth in 2025–2026.

entities.name: Table T2 – Macro China economic performance from 2019 to 2027
entities.brief: China’s CAI and GDP performance 2019–2027
entities.description: Shows China’s Current Activity Indicator and GDP volatility around pandemic, troughs and rebounds, with forecasts easing from 4.7% to 3.9%.

properties.key_insight: China’s economy showed extreme CAI and GDP swings during 2020–2023 with troughs and rebounds, then stabilized with GDP forecasts easing from 4.7% in 2025 to 3.9% in 2026.

entities.name: Table T3 – Macro Euro area GDP vs CAI 2019-2027
entities.brief: Euro area CAI and GDP fluctuations
entities.description: Illustrates Euro area CAI and GDP plunges in mid-2020 and subsequent rebounds, with forecasts of modest growth in 2025–2026.

properties.key_insight: The Euro area saw CAI and GDP plunge to -30% and -17% in mid-2020, then rebound sharply and stabilize near 0–1% with GDP growth forecasts of 1.0% in 2025 and 1.1% in 2026.

entities.name: Table T4 – Macro US GDP vs CAI 2019-2027
entities.brief: US CAI and GDP growth trends
entities.description: Traces US CAI and GDP volatility during pandemic and stabilization thereafter, forecasting consistent 1.6% GDP growth.

properties.key_insight: US CAI dropped to -30% in 2020 and rebounded to 24% by early 2021, with GDP also dipping then recovering, stabilizing between 0% and 3%, and forecasts of 1.6% for 2025 and 2026.
